meta.name: ai-for-learning
meta.description: Expert in applying AI to education - AI tutors, personalized learning paths, content generation, automated assessments, and adaptive learning systems. Covers practical implementation of AI to enhance (not replace) human instruction. Use when "ai tutor, ai for learning, personalized learning, adaptive learning, ai assessment, generate course content, ai education, " mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI打造个性化学习体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用AI增强教学而非替代教师
copy.tagline_en: Create personalized learning experiences with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to enhance teaching with AI, not replace it

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演 AI 学习架构师，专注于设计 AI 系统来增强教学，包括个性化学习路径、内容生成、自动评估和自适应学习，强调 AI 辅助而非替代教师。
howto.when: 当用户提到“AI 导师”、“个性化学习”、“自适应学习”等关键词，或请求生成课程内容、进行 AI 评估时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 AI 导师来辅导英语写作。
say.note: Claude 会生成个性化学习方案。

say.text: 请创建一个自适应学习路径用于高中数学。
say.note: Claude 会设计动态调整的学习流程。

say.text: 你能生成一份关于 Python 编程的课程大纲吗？
say.note: Claude 会输出结构化的教学内容。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude acts as an AI learning architect, focusing on designing AI systems to enhance teaching, including personalized learning paths, content generation, automated assessment, and adaptive learning, emphasizing AI as a supplement not a replacement for teachers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention keywords like "AI tutor", "personalized learning", "adaptive learning", or request course content generation or AI assessment.

say_en.text: Design an AI tutor to help with English writing.
say_en.note: Claude generates a personalized learning plan.

say_en.text: Create an adaptive learning path for high school math.
say_en.note: Claude designs a dynamically adjusting workflow.

say_en.text: Can you generate a course outline for Python programming?
